{DRAFT}
Key agreement - no KDF
⌈
If the transformation
specified by the AlgId used to create this context does not include a KDF and
no
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyDerivationFunctionCtx
is explicitly provided by
calling
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::SetKDF
, the inter-
face
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::AgreeKey
and
ara::
crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::AgreeSeed
shall return the calcu-
lated shared secret. Otherwise the output of key-derivation using the shared secret as
input shall be returned.
⌋
